title: EmbeddingResult
description: Schema for embedding generation output from the AI Worker, including 768-dimensional vectors and chunk provenance metadata.

schema_version.description: The version of this embedding result schema.

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient whose chunks were embedded.

embedding_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when embedding generation was performed.

embedding_model.description: Model used for embedding generation (e.g., text-embedding-004).

embedding_dimensions.description: Dimensionality of the embedding vectors (must be 768).

source_documents.description: List of source document IDs that contributed to the embedded chunks.

results.description: Array of embedding results, one per input chunk.

EmbeddingResultItem.description: Embedding result for a single chunk, either successful or failed.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based index of the source chunk.

status.description: Status of embedding generation for this chunk.

normalized.description: Whether L2 normalization was applied to the embedding.

document_id.description: Primary source document identifier for this chunk.

text_content.description: Original chunk text (optional, may be omitted to reduce payload size).

token_count.description: Number of tokens in the source chunk.

chunk_hash.description: Hash of the chunk text for deduplication/integrity.

provenance.description: Source provenance entries for this chunk.

ProvenanceEntry.description: Provenance metadata linking chunk content to source document location.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) in the source document.

coordinates.description: Bounding box coordinates from source document.

start_offset.description: Character offset where this provenance entry starts within the chunk text.

end_offset.description: Character offset where this provenance entry ends within the chunk text.
